title: Wishes & Hypothetical Structures
description: Master wishes and hypothetical structures for Grade 9: wish + past/past perfect, if only, it's high time, would rather, and as if/as though — bilingual notes, practice and tests.

topics.title: Wish & If Only
topics.concept:
wish expresses a desire for a different reality. The tense shows the time:

  • Present/general wish → wish + past simple: I wish I had more time. (Use 'were' for all subjects: I wish I were taller.)
  • Past regret → wish + past perfect: I wish I had listened to you.
  • Annoyance / desire for change → wish + would + base verb: I wish you would stop shouting. (used for another person's behaviour, not your own)

if only works exactly like 'wish' but is stronger and more emotional: If only I were younger! If only I had known!

examples.solution: were — present wish uses the past; 'were' for all subjects.
had told — past regret uses the past perfect.

recap: Present wish → wish + past simple (were for all subjects)
wish + would = annoyance / desire for another's change

topics.title: It's (High) Time, Would Rather & As If/As Though
topics.concept:
It's (high) time means something is overdue. It is followed by the past tense (with a present meaning):

  • It's time we left. (= we should leave now)
  • It's high time you apologised.

would rather shows preference:

  • Own action → would rather + base verb: I'd rather stay home.
  • Someone else's action → would rather + past tense: I'd rather you came tomorrow.

as if / as though introduces an unreal comparison; use the past for something untrue now:

  • She acts as if she owned the place. (she doesn't)
  • He talks as though he knew everything.

examples.solution: started — 'it's high time' takes the past tense.

examples.problem: Complete: He behaves as if he ___ (be) the boss.
examples.solution: were — an unreal comparison uses the past ('were' for all subjects).

recap: It's (high) time + past tense (overdue, present meaning)
would rather + base (own action) / + past (another's action)
as if/as though + past tense for something untrue now

outcomes: Use 'wish' for present, past and future situations
Use 'if only' for strong wishes and regrets
Use 'as if / as though' for unreal comparisons

intro.en: Hypothetical language lets us talk about things that are not real — wishes, regrets, and imagined situations. The surprising rule is that English uses past tenses to talk about the present in these structures: "I wish I were taller" is about now, not the past. Master this 'unreal past' and you unlock elegant, expressive English.
intro.hi: काल्पनिक भाषा हमें उन बातों की चर्चा करने देती है जो वास्तविक नहीं हैं — इच्छाएँ, पछतावे और कल्पित स्थितियाँ। चौंकाने वाला नियम यह है कि इन संरचनाओं में अंग्रेज़ी वर्तमान की बात करने के लिए भूतकाल का प्रयोग करती है: "I wish I were taller" अभी के बारे में है, भूत के बारे में नहीं। इस 'unreal past' को समझ लें तो सुंदर, भावपूर्ण अंग्रेज़ी खुल जाती है।

real_life.situation:
A moment of reflection:

You: I wish I knew the answer. If only I had studied harder! It's high time I started revising.
real_life.why: Three regrets, three patterns — a present wish (wish + past), a past regret (if only + past perfect), and an overdue action (it's high time + past). All use a past tense to talk about now or recent time. That is the hallmark of hypothetical English.

rule_box.html:
StructureFormMeaning
wish (present)wish + pastI wish I were rich.
wish (past)wish + past perfectI wish I had gone.
wish (future)wish + wouldI wish it would stop.
it's (high) time+ pastIt's time we left.
would rather+ base / + pastI'd rather stay / I'd rather you stayed.
rule_box.formula: Unreal present → past tense · Unreal past → past perfect
rule_box.example: I wish I knew (now); I wish I had known (then); I'd rather you came tomorrow.

words.meaning: past form for a present idea

quick_test.q: 'It's high time you ___ home.' Which form fits?
quick_test.explanation: 'It's (high) time' is followed by the past tense ('went').

common_mistakes.note: A present wish uses the past ('were').
A past regret uses the past perfect, not 'would have'.

common_mistakes.wrong: She acts as if she is a queen.
common_mistakes.right: She acts as if she were a queen.
common_mistakes.note: An unreal comparison takes the past ('were').

answers: It's high time + past → overdue action

reading.passage: Standing on the empty platform, Aman sighed. "I wish I had caught that train," he thought. "If only I were faster!" He checked his watch. "It's high time I bought a better one," he muttered. A stranger nearby was talking loudly, as if he owned the whole station. Aman would rather have waited in silence.

questions.q: Identify a past regret and explain its form.
questions.answer: "I wish I had caught that train" — wish + past perfect for a past regret.

questions.q: Why is 'were' used in 'If only I were faster'?
questions.answer: It is a present (unreal) wish, which takes the past — 'were' for all subjects.

questions.q: Explain 'as if he owned the whole station'.
questions.answer: An unreal comparison: he does not own it, so the past 'owned' is used after 'as if'.

writing.example: I wish I were braver. If only I had started earlier. It's high time I exercised. I'd rather read than watch TV.
